name: dev-agent
description: Deep autonomous AI developer agent: idea -> architecture spec -> UX design -> implement -> test -> optional browser-based visual QA -> security/performance/final review -> Definition of Done, with automatic retry loops and persistent resumable execution state. Framework-agnostic -- inspects the target project to detect its stack and capabilities (Playwright optional, never auto-installed). Enforces a verified target-project boundary at the tool layer to prevent cross-project file modification.
